sloka: इत्येव विलपन्तीनाम् स्त्रीणाम् वेश्मसु राघवम् ।जगामास्तम् दिनकरो रजनी चाभ्यवर्तत ॥२-४८-३३॥
transliteration: ityeva vilapantīnām strīṇām veśmasu rāghavam ।jagāmāstam dinakaro rajanī cābhyavartata ॥2-48-33॥

translations.english: As the women of the city were thus lamenting over the scion of the Raghus (Rama) (sitting) at home, the sun set. Night fell.
